summary: Frontier Group Holdings filed an 8-K on August 25, 2026, disclosing an agreement with lessors to early terminate leases on 13 A320neo aircraft, returning them in H2 2026. This reduces operating lease assets and liabilities by ~$260 million and incurs non-cash charges of $60–80 million and cash charges of $90–120 million, mainly settled in 2028–2029. Separately, it agreed to direct lease 10 A321neo aircraft from AerCap, delivering Q4 2026–Q1 2027. The moves optimize fleet capacity and reduce maintenance costs. Watch for actual charge timing and fleet transition execution.
